Prior review retained below:
Reread all 240 individual rationales against the exact questions in a separate pass after drafting. Checked direction, scope, current implementation and source fit, without score targets or copying other countries. Verified PM Lawrence Wong and President Tharman against current official pages. Crosschecked primary institutions with Freedom House, Human Rights Watch, Associated Press, IMF, WTO and State Media Monitor; these publishers are not all independent of the Singapore government in the same way, and government ministries are not counted as independent corroborators. Review corrections: used exact serious-incident personal-search powers instead of vehicle roadblocks; resolved disarmament using binding Chemical Weapons Convention obligations; verified the Temasek/Mediacorp ownership chain; verified April 2025 ComCare social-participation provision; checked constitutional recall/repeal mechanisms, current capital-transfer commitments, private rent law and current trade-remedies law; corrected AI validation release date to 11 December 2024. Religion funding is unknown because statutory administration does not establish the source of funds. Implementation boundaries: 10-week shared parental leave is effective April 2026, enhanced temporary ComCare assistance began August 2026, enterprise-loan enhancement began September 2026, and Muslim education registration rules took effect 2 October 2026. Workplace Fairness implementation remains targeted for late 2027 and is not credited as current. Final October 2025 BAC genome advice is distinguished from a legal ban, and healthy enhancement is not inferred from therapeutic-device rules. Culture/Nature draws on publicly distributed trait-specific guidance, not religion, traditional family policy or research funding alone; its interaction answers warrant independent review of generalisation from child development and clinical anxiety. Publicly distributed guidance is evidence of the institution’s communicated causal model, not a claim that all of its scientific claims are correct. Parent owns independent audit and shared credits/archive/build. No archive or publication performed. Validation run: profiles validate country singapore reported only the 33 deliberate unknown responses as errors; the one warning is Culture/Nature’s 7 of 16 supported Neutral responses. No neighbours were calculated while incomplete. Structural checks confirmed 240 unique IDs, 16 per axis, all source references resolvable, and consistent unknown/null pairing. No scores or similarity conclusions are claimed. Separate completion challenge 2026-10-05: checked each new estimate against exact statements and previous withdrawal reasons. Reread the current population speech: annual targets are expressly flexible, cultural integration and population composition are not uniform source-country similarity tests, and diversity appreciation does not automatically imply larger admissions. Reread the adopted ASEAN military-AI statement: development plus human responsibility supports a conditional estimate, not a verified per-strike rule. Religious funding remains explicitly provisional after renewed official-source search; general appropriations and statutory religious administration do not isolate belief-strengthening purpose, while verified madrasah support distinguishes secular subjects. Territorial self-government differs from nonterritorial Malay recognition. New healthy-implant responses are estimates, not therapeutic-device permissions. Read every neutral rationale on ownership and causal axes: commercial/public structures and communicated gene-environment interaction justify retained mixed choices, without automatic neutrality for uncertainty. Existing full review retained; no independent human or second-agent review claimed. Separate response-direction correction review on 2026-10-05: compared all first-six-axis rationales with literal questions. Authority-liberty-10 asks for unverified communication, so qualified support for verification means disagreement (-1), not agreement. Nationalism-internationalism-05 asks for withdrawal without outside approval, so national sovereignty supports agreement (+1), not disagreement. All other first-six-axis signs remain consistent with their explanations. Existing evidence and the distinct earlier completion challenge remain applicable; this correction does not claim new independent peer review. Remaining nine axes retain their existing evidence review. Two correction source pages were reread; no changes made solely for similarity.

Additional challenge of authority-liberty-10 refined the correction from -1 to 0 before archival: reread the current 2026 messaging code and IMDA consultation response, distinguishing private login verification, selected government-record commerce verification and registered mobile access. These support a conditional channel-specific mixed response, not a blanket government verification obligation. Compliance due January 2027 is not implemented by the October cutoff. The final correction is therefore a rationale and estimate refinement, rather than a simple sign reversal for this item.

neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Institutional inference: Constitutional supremacy and judicial review coexist with substantial executive influence and limited practical independence; neither unrestricted judicial checking nor its total abolition describes the system. Most likely Neutral. The cited facts provide contextual evidence for an institutional estimate, not a verified explicit national endorsement of this exact statement. Formal constitutional provisions do not alone establish their practical independence or an explicit endorsement of the exact institutional rule.

Educated assumption: The implemented framework distinguishes ordinary communication safeguards from government-record verification for selected commerce accounts and registered mobile connections. A conditional mixed response is likelier than either universally unverified communication or universal government identity verification. The 2026 messaging code adds anti-scam duties, with most compliance due in January 2027, and is not treated as fully implemented by the cutoff. Revision 1’s rationale incorrectly treated sector-specific verification as general agreement with this opposite-worded question.
